name: BiggerPicture
long_description:
BiggerPicture, Inc. runs the largest freight scheduling network in the industry.

It is a freight appointment network. Carriers, shippers, and facilities work from one shared shipment record, so the appointment a carrier requests is the same appointment the facility confirms and the shipper sees. Nothing to reconcile between systems, no email threads to chase.

One workspace covers every scheduling channel: email, bulk email, and direct portal integrations. Automation handles routine booking and routes anything that needs a human into an exception queue. Every party is graded on one shared, published compliance standard rather than each provider's own unpublished metrics.

Some of the largest brokers and carriers in the country run on our network. SOC 2 Type II. Women-led.
one_liner: The largest freight scheduling network in the industry.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Deema spent 15 years in leadership roles at Coyote Logistics and Uber Freight, driving significant innovation in the supply chain industry.  During that time, she felt the acute challenges of siloed technology and workflows across the supply chain resulted in less than 1% of shipments could be handled without human intervention, which propelled her to found BiggerPicture.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: During his 13 years working at startups as well as hyper-growth companies such as Datadog and Dassault Systèmes, Guillaume developed a passion for solving complex problems with simple solutions. He takes pride in shaping and crafting stunning user experiences for high volume and critical applications.
